original_question: My garlic field is 0.22 hectares and has Vertisol soil. An agricultural adviser gave me a plan of 92 kg nitrogen, 40 kg phosphorus, 30 kg sulfur and 140 kg potassium chloride per hectare. How much of each of those do I need for my field? Are the first three amounts nutrients or bags of fertilizer?
